title: A drawn emblem becomes a 3D sting with sound
pitch: An emblem with no lettering in. A bronze 3D version, turning, with an original sound out.
why: Krea 2 draws the emblem, TRELLIS.2 gives it depth, Blender turns it under studio light, and ACE-Step writes the hit under it.

models.name: Krea 2
models.note: Read the terms before commercial use.

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Ask for a symbol with no letters: image models still write gibberish when asked for words.

steps.label: The emblem
steps.prompt: A heavy cast bronze emblem: a stylised fox head inside a thick round ring, no letters, no words, a single object, the whole object in view, centred, three-quarter view, plain light grey studio background, soft even light.

steps.label: Textured mesh
steps.does: Cuts the object out and builds a textured mesh from one picture.

steps.label: Turning in light
steps.does: Real size, pivot at the base, a collider and a turntable, in Blender.

steps.label: The sting

94.tags: Cinematic logo sting: deep brass hit, rising shimmer, warm reverb tail, short, no vocals

steps.does: An eight-second sound for the turn.

steps.label: Picture and sound
steps.does: Lays the sting under the turntable.
